summary.zh: 危險訊號 16 檔、偏多僅 1 檔，NVDA 重挫 14.01%，半導體與大型科技股多檔跌破布林下軌
summary.en: 16 warning signals vs only 1 bullish; NVDA plunged 14.01% and many chip and big-tech names broke below the lower Bollinger Band

text.zh: COST 上漲 0.76%，出現 50／200 日線黃金交叉，MACD 偏多、均線多頭排列，RSI 69.7 接近 70
text.en: COST rose 0.76% with a 50/200-day golden cross; MACD bullish, MAs in bullish alignment, RSI 69.7 near 70

text.zh: TSLA 下跌 7.64% 並跌破布林下軌，MACD 偏空、均線盤整，RSI 37.8
text.en: TSLA fell 7.64% and broke below the lower Bollinger Band; MACD bearish, MAs range-bound, RSI 37.8

text.zh: AMZN 下跌 4.1%，出現 MACD 死亡交叉，均線盤整，RSI 42.3
text.en: AMZN fell 4.1% with a MACD death cross; MAs range-bound, RSI 42.3

text.zh: XLE 下跌 0.62%，MACD 偏空、均線盤整，RSI 34.7 偏低
text.en: XLE fell 0.62%; MACD bearish, MAs range-bound, RSI 34.7 on the low side

text.zh: LLY 下跌 0.3%，MACD 偏空、均線盤整，RSI 49.7
text.en: LLY fell 0.3%; MACD bearish, MAs range-bound, RSI 49.7

text.zh: NVDA 重挫 14.01%、SMH 下跌 10.6%、TSM 下跌 9.48%，三者都跌破布林下軌
text.en: NVDA plunged 14.01%, SMH fell 10.6% and TSM fell 9.48%; all three broke below the lower Bollinger Band

text.zh: AMD 下跌 13.25%，同時出現 MACD 死亡交叉並跌破 200 日線
text.en: AMD fell 13.25% with a MACD death cross and a break below its 200-day MA

text.zh: 聯發科（2454.TW）下跌 9.95%，MACD 死亡交叉、跌破 200 日線與布林下軌三個訊號同時出現
text.en: MediaTek (2454.TW) fell 9.95%, triggering a MACD death cross, a break below the 200-day MA and the lower Bollinger Band at once

text.zh: QQQ 下跌 5.67%、ORCL 下跌 8.48%、MSFT 下跌 2.77%，皆跌破布林下軌
text.en: QQQ fell 5.67%, ORCL 8.48% and MSFT 2.77%; all broke below the lower Bollinger Band

text.zh: META、GOOGL、GE 出現 MACD 死亡交叉；BRK-B、XLV 出現 RSI 急轉直下
text.en: META, GOOGL and GE posted MACD death crosses; BRK-B and XLV showed sharp RSI drops

text.zh: 偏多訊號只有 COST 一檔（50／200 日線黃金交叉），在全面下跌中相對獨立
text.en: COST is the only bullish signal (50/200-day golden cross), standing apart from the broad decline

summary.zh: AI 類股拋售讓那斯達克抹去今年漲幅，NVDA 傳出會計受 SEC 調查，中東局勢仍緊張
summary.en: An AI-stock sell-off erased the Nasdaq's 2026 gains, NVDA's accounting reportedly faces an SEC probe, and Middle East tensions persist

text.zh: CNBC：AI 類股跌勢加劇，那斯達克 2026 年漲幅全部抹去，Alphabet 被點名為科技股中的亮點
text.en: CNBC: an intensifying AI rout wiped out the Nasdaq's 2026 gains, with Alphabet cited as a tech bright spot

text.zh: Reuters 獨家：消息人士稱 NVIDIA 的會計處理是美國 SEC 調查的重點
text.en: Reuters exclusive: sources say Nvidia's accounting is a focus of a US SEC investigation

text.zh: 伊朗局勢：伊朗外長表示希望以外交結束戰爭，川普稱條件無法接受；美國財政部制裁替伊朗收取石油收入的人士
text.en: Iran: its foreign minister says Iran wants diplomacy to end the war while Trump calls the terms unacceptable; US Treasury sanctioned 'trustees' collecting Iranian oil revenue

text.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯表示攔截三枚胡塞飛彈；川普稱與普丁就烏克蘭談得不錯，但未承諾安全保證
text.en: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted three Houthi missiles; Trump cited good talks with Putin on Ukraine but held back on security guarantees

text.zh: COST：系統當機潮帶動囤貨，推升 Costco 銷售；另有報導談股市拋售與債市買盤對房貸利率的影響
text.en: COST: outages are spurring bulk shopping and a wave of Costco sales; another story covers how the sell-off and bond demand affect mortgage rates

text.zh: TSLA：Cybercab 擴展到達拉斯；另有報導討論 AI 在華爾街的熱潮是否已結束
text.en: TSLA: Cybercab expands to Dallas; another story asks whether AI's honeymoon on Wall Street has ended

text.zh: AMZN：re:Invent 大會將於 11 月 30 日開始，報導回顧過去 10 次大會後一個月的股價表現
text.en: AMZN: re:Invent starts Nov. 30; a story reviews the stock's moves in the month after the last 10 conferences

text.zh: XLE：能源類股週五下午一度走高，收盤轉為下跌
text.en: XLE: energy stocks advanced Friday afternoon but closed lower

text.zh: LLY：ObesityWeek 後的評價討論，以及與 Merck、AbbVie 的比較文章
text.en: LLY: valuation discussion after ObesityWeek and comparison pieces versus Merck and AbbVie

text.zh: 素材中未來 7 天沒有觀察清單股票公布財報
text.en: No watch-list earnings reports in the next 7 days in the materials

summary.zh: 多檔科技股貼近 52 週低點，NVDA 距低點僅 0.83%；COST、SGOV 則在 52 週高點附近
summary.en: Several tech names sit near 52-week lows, NVDA just 0.83% above its low; COST and SGOV are near 52-week highs

text.zh: 本益比最高：TSLA 380.02、PLTR 101.05、AMD 98.24、聯發科 57.04、COST 53.09
text.en: Highest P/E: TSLA 380.02, PLTR 101.05, AMD 98.24, MediaTek 57.04, COST 53.09

text.zh: 本益比最低：GS 11.37、鴻海 12.79、JPM 13.43、GOOGL 13.85、VXUS 13.87
text.en: Lowest P/E: GS 11.37, Hon Hai 12.79, JPM 13.43, GOOGL 13.85, VXUS 13.87

text.zh: NVDA 本益比 15.67、預估本益比 7.56，在大跌後落在觀察清單偏低的位置
text.en: NVDA trades at a P/E of 15.67 and forward P/E of 7.56, on the low end of the watch list after the drop
Highest yields: 006208.TW 4.26%, BND 4.14%, VNQ 3.68%, SGOV 3.62%, CVX 3.42%

text.zh: 接近 52 週低點：GOOGL 0.4%、CAT 0.46%、GLD 0.6%、NVDA 0.83%、ORCL 0.94%（距低點）
text.en: Near 52-week lows: GOOGL 0.4%, CAT 0.46%, GLD 0.6%, NVDA 0.83%, ORCL 0.94% above their lows

text.zh: ORCL 距 52 週高點 -59.27%、CAT -52.25%、NVDA -48.42%，回檔幅度最深
text.en: ORCL is 59.27% below its 52-week high, CAT 52.25% and NVDA 48.42%, the deepest pullbacks

text.zh: 接近 52 週高點：SGOV 0%、COST -1.92%、BND -2.23%、PG -2.43%
text.en: Near 52-week highs: SGOV 0%, COST -1.92%, BND -2.23%, PG -2.43%

text.zh: TSLA 本益比 380.02、距高點 -30.67%；AMZN 本益比 19.95、距高點 -14.06%
text.en: TSLA: P/E 380.02, 30.67% below its high; AMZN: P/E 19.95, 14.06% below its high

text.zh: LLY 本益比 43.85、距高點 -8.69%；XLE 本益比 15.11、殖利率 2.52%
text.en: LLY: P/E 43.85, 8.69% below its high; XLE: P/E 15.11, yield 2.52%

summary.zh: 跌勢集中在 AI 與半導體，防禦股逆勢上漲；多方看評價下修，空方看恐慌狀態與 SEC 消息
summary.en: Losses centered on AI and chips while defensives rose; bulls point to lower valuations, bears to the panic regime and SEC news

text.zh: 漲幅前三名為 UNH 2.84%、WMT 1.52%、JNJ 1.25%，資金轉向防禦類股，並非全面撤出
text.en: Top gainers were UNH 2.84%, WMT 1.52% and JNJ 1.25%, suggesting rotation into defensives rather than a full exit

text.zh: NVDA 大跌後預估本益比 7.56、GOOGL 本益比 13.85，評價已明顯下修
text.en: After the drop NVDA's forward P/E is 7.56 and GOOGL's P/E is 13.85, showing a clear valuation reset

text.zh: COST 出現 50／200 日線黃金交叉，均線多頭排列，距 52 週高點僅 -1.92%
text.en: COST posted a 50/200-day golden cross with MAs in bullish alignment, only 1.92% below its 52-week high

text.zh: 新聞提到 Alphabet 是科技股中的亮點，AMZN 的 re:Invent 大會將在 11 月 30 日登場
text.en: News cites Alphabet as a tech bright spot, and AMZN's re:Invent conference begins Nov. 30

text.zh: VOO 與 0050 都進入「高波動（恐慌）」狀態，VOO 近 20 日 -9%、0050 近 20 日 -16.6%
text.en: Both VOO and 0050 are in the 'high volatility (panic)' regime; VOO is -9% over 20 days and 0050 -16.6%

text.zh: QQQ 單日 -5.67%、30 天 -18.44%，漲跌家數 14 比 34，上漲比例僅約 29%
text.en: QQQ fell 5.67% on the day and 18.44% over 30 days; breadth was 14 up vs 34 down, only about 29% advancing

text.zh: 報導稱 NVIDIA 會計受 SEC 調查，NVDA、AMD、AVGO 單日跌幅都超過 12%
text.en: Reports say Nvidia's accounting faces an SEC probe; NVDA, AMD and AVGO each fell more than 12% on the day

text.zh: GOOGL、CAT、NVDA、ORCL 距 52 週低點都不到 1%，低點支撐面臨考驗
text.en: GOOGL, CAT, NVDA and ORCL are all within 1% of their 52-week lows, testing support

text.zh: 伊朗、胡塞飛彈與烏克蘭等地緣政治消息仍多，增加不確定性
text.en: Geopolitical headlines on Iran, Houthi missiles and Ukraine keep uncertainty elevated

summary.zh: AI 與半導體股重挫，美股與台股同處恐慌狀態，防禦股相對抗跌
summary.en: AI and chip stocks plunged, US and Taiwan markets are both in the panic regime, and defensives held up better

text.zh: 半導體領跌：NVDA -14.01%、AMD -13.25%、AVGO -12.19%，QQQ 單日 -5.67%，VOO 進入恐慌狀態
text.en: Chips led the decline: NVDA -14.01%, AMD -13.25%, AVGO -12.19%; QQQ fell 5.67% and VOO entered the panic regime

text.zh: 新聞面：AI 類股拋售讓那斯達克抹去今年漲幅，NVIDIA 會計傳出受 SEC 調查
text.en: News: an AI sell-off erased the Nasdaq's 2026 gains, and Nvidia's accounting is reportedly under SEC investigation

text.zh: 危險訊號 16 檔、偏多僅 COST 一檔；台股 0050 已連續 9 天處於恐慌狀態，近 20 日 -16.6%
text.en: 16 warning signals vs only COST as bullish; Taiwan's 0050 has been in the panic regime for 9 days, -16.6% over 20 days

text.zh: 防禦類股逆勢：UNH +2.84%、WMT +1.52%、JNJ +1.25%；COST、SGOV、BND 接近 52 週高點
text.en: Defensives bucked the trend: UNH +2.84%, WMT +1.52%, JNJ +1.25%; COST, SGOV and BND are near 52-week highs
